title: Repository cleanup and organization audit
description: Comprehensive review of geobeat repository structure, documentation, and organization. Remove unnecessary files, organize docs, apply best practices, make repo presentation-ready for external viewers

title: Audit root directory for clutter
description: Review root level files, identify unnecessary configs, old planning docs, temporary files. Move or delete as appropriate

title: Review and organize documentation structure
description: Audit docs/ directory, check for outdated/duplicate docs, ensure consistent formatting, create docs index if helpful

title: Clean up data-sources directory
description: Review data-sources structure, ensure armiarma submodule is properly configured, remove any cruft

title: Audit frontend structure and remove unused files
description: Review src/frontend/geobeat-ui for unused components, old configs, temp files, ensure clean structure

title: Update README.md for professional presentation
description: Review README, ensure it reflects current architecture, has clear setup instructions, looks professional for external viewers

title: Review .gitignore and ensure proper exclusions
description: Audit .gitignore for completeness, ensure all temp files, credentials, build artifacts properly excluded

title: Update README to match Astral style guide
description: Rewrite README with calm, technical tone: remove emojis, avoid hype, focus on utility, use active voice, demonstrate value through working code

title: Move internal planning docs out of root
description: Move CLEANUP_PLAN.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and other internal docs to appropriate locations. Keep root minimal and professional

title: Deploy Armiarma Network Crawler to Remote Server
Phase 1: Server Provisioning (Hetzner CPX41)
description: Provision Hetzner CPX41 server with Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, configure SSH authentication, disable password auth, create deployment user

title: Order Hetzner CPX41 server with SSH key
description: Create Hetzner account, order CPX41 server (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS), add SSH public key during setup

title: Verify SSH access to server
description: Test SSH connection using project key, verify root access, update SSH config with server IP

title: Disable password authentication
description: Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config to disable password auth, restart sshd service

title: Create armiarma deployment user
description: Create non-root user 'armiarma' with sudo access, copy SSH key, verify sudo permissions

title: Review Hetzner server options and storage capacity
description: Verify CPX41 specs vs alternatives, confirm storage capacity (320GB if shared vs 240GB if CPX), document chosen configuration

title: Phase 2: Security Hardening (UFW, secrets, Docker)
description: Configure UFW firewall, generate database credentials, add resource limits to docker-compose, configure log rotation, install fail2ban

title: Phase 3: Application Deployment
description: Install Docker, create directory structure, copy armiarma files, create env files, build and start services, verify deployment

title: Phase 4: Systemd Service Setup
description: Create systemd service file, enable auto-start on boot, test service management and auto-restart

title: Phase 5: Backup & Data Persistence
description: Create daily backup script with pg_dump, configure cron job, test restoration process, optionally configure off-site backups

title: Phase 6: Monitoring & Alerting
description: Create Prometheus alert rules, configure notification channels, test alerts, document runbook procedures

title: Set up DNS and domain architecture
description: Configure geobeat.xyz DNS: api.geobeat.xyz for Hetzner API server, app.geobeat.xyz for Vercel frontend, set up SSL certificates
